plugin.description: Control the computer itself: run commands, launch apps, press hotkeys, type text and show CPU/RAM usage.
plugin.requirements: Nothing extra. Commands run on the host, also when StreamController is a Flatpak.

RunCommand.description: Runs a shell command with extras: showing the output on the key, re-running it on a timer, or going through an interactive shell. For simply starting something, use Easy Run Command instead.

detached.description: Let the command keep running after it was started. Leave this on for launching apps.

interactive_shell.description: Run through an interactive login shell, so aliases and shell functions work.

display_output.description: Show the command's output on the key instead of just running it.

label_position.description: Which label row the output goes into. Only used with display_output.

auto_run.description: Re-run the command every N seconds. 0 disables it. Use this together with display_output for a live readout.

EasyCommand.description: Runs a shell command. This is the action to use for starting an app or running anything on the system - it needs nothing but the command itself. Prefer it over Run Command unless you need output on the key or a repeat timer.

Launch.description: Starts an installed application from its desktop entry. Prefer RunCommand when you only know the app's name.

OpenInBrowser.description: Opens a URL in the default browser.

new_window.description: Open in a new window instead of a new tab.

EasyHotkey.description: Presses a key combination, as if the user had pressed it on the keyboard.
EasyHotkey.requirements: On Wayland this needs the input permission; the plugin asks for it on first use.

Hotkey.description: Presses a key combination recorded through the UI. Use EasyHotkey when configuring from a description - it takes the combination as plain text.

WriteText.description: Types a piece of text into whatever window has focus.

Delay.description: Waits before the next action on the same event runs. Put it between two actions to space them out.

MoveXY.description: Moves the mouse pointer to a screen position.

Click.description: Clicks a mouse button at the pointer's current position.

CPU.description: Shows current CPU usage on the key. Needs no trigger - it updates itself.

RAM.description: Shows current RAM usage on the key. Needs no trigger - it updates itself.

CPUTemp.description: Shows the CPU temperature on the key. Updates itself.

CPU_Graph.description: Draws CPU usage over time as a graph on the key. Updates itself.

RAM_Graph.description: Draws RAM usage over time as a graph on the key. Updates itself.

Ping.description: Pings a host and shows the round trip time on the key.
